description: Pause or resume an inbox, or change its folder, texts, password, expiry or limits.

active.description: false pauses the inbox, true resumes it

allowedFileTypes.description: Extensions accepted, such as "pdf" or "jpg"; empty accepts any

anyOf.description: When the inbox stops accepting files, an ISO 8601 date

expiresAt.description: A new closing date (ISO 8601), or null to remove it

maxFileSize.description: A new largest file in bytes, or null to remove it

maxUploads.description: A new upload limit, or null to remove it

password.description: A new password, or null to remove it

visitorIdentity.description: Whether visitors give their name and email

name: update_inbox
title: Change an inbox
